description: MOLTSA supports thermochemical assessment of molten salts used in reactor and thermal-system research. Jack A. Wilson and collaborators provide an R Shiny application that compares literature measurements with modelled phase equilibria and enthalpies. Tools include heat-capacity fitting, calorimetry calibration and uncertainty calculations, ternary visualization and retrieval of optimizer inputs. Coverage is defined by the chemical systems, temperature ranges and measurements supplied, not a geographic grid or observation period. The results can prepare material properties for related energy and industrial simulations. Software source is free under GPL-3.0, with local setup instructions and a hosted-site link. Underlying literature datasets have their own attribution and rights. A limitation is dependence on data coverage and thermodynamic assumptions, with separate proprietary tools involved in some compatible workflows. The hosted application and contributor access were not tested. No thermochemical data, optimizer file or installer was downloaded.
licence: GPL-3.0 for software; underlying literature-data rights remain source-specific
